name: Projector Throw
description: The lights go down on the first clip and a projector throws the second onto it: a small, blurred, keystoned picture of light lands on the scene, then grows, comes into focus and squares up until it fills the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: darkness
params.description: How dark the first clip gets once the lights go down

params.name: keystone
params.description: How much wider the top of the projected picture is than its bottom when it lands

params.name: blur
params.description: How out of focus the projected picture is when it lands, in frame heights
